description: Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education - Amend the entry in Gazette Ex. Gazette No. 1567/23 of 19.09.2008 which Specifies the Faculties Department
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an official order issued under statutory authority (Section 27(1) of the Act) to modify the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Ruhuna. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending existing legislation and institutional structures rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
